_note: Screenshots the payload expects. None exists yet: the integration phase captures each one in THIS lab from our own installation of the Netresearch extension named, in light mode, saves it under the name given and reruns sitepackage:seed-netresearch-talk. The seeder skips a missing file (and says so). Never copy Netresearch’s screenshots. To replace a capture, overwrite the file under the same name and rerun the seeder: it replaces the stored copy whose SHA-1 differs in place (same sys_file uid, so every language keeps it; TYPO3 regenerates the processed variants) and flushes the pages that show it.
